name: Photo Stylist
tagline: Style critique and restyle ideas from one full-length photo
description: Send a full-length photo and get a straight assessment of what is working and what is not, followed by restyle suggestions, hair and glasses options, and put-together looks for specific occasions. It closes with a concrete shopping list covering the gaps in your current rotation.
